title: 12.88万起、华为电驱+L4同源智驾，Ray7能成为埃安年轻化的答卷吗？
summary: 10月17日，埃安轿跑Ray7正式开启预售，预售价12.88 万起。新车车长4.9米，轴距2.9米，车头部分搭配3.25米的超长双环灯带，是埃安10年焕新的家族式标识。 新车采用宁德时代电池以及广汽自研的弹匣电池2.0技术，能够在充分释放续航能力的同时，监控电池健康状态。提供45.58kWh和62.98kWh两种规格，续航可达702公里，整车风阻系数 Cd 低至 0.22。 Ray7搭载华为DriveONE多合一电驱，以及华为DriveONE芯片级驱制融合架构，百公里制动仅为32.8米。 底盘方面，Ray7搭载高性能前后稳定杆和后五连杆悬架，过弯极限更高，滤振更干净。 智能化上， Ray7搭载27颗车规级全视角传感器，采用文远知行L4级Robotaxi同源大模型。这帮助新车能够复用 L4 积累的海量场景经验，在城区掉头、绕行等复杂场景中可顺利通行。 自2025年广汽推进“番禺行动”以来，昊铂埃安BU的研发、生产、销售等环节效率不断提升，产品迭代和新车投放节奏明显加快。作为埃安全新Ray车系的首款新车，Ray7是埃安开启年轻化序列的关键落子，也是广汽切入20万级市场的重要布局。 这一细分市场竞争并不轻松：小鹏P7、极氪007等车型已经提前卡位。Ray7想在年轻人心中占位，不能只堆参数，更要把智能座舱与辅助驾驶、三电安全、补能效率、用车成本和价格权益上的差异，变成用户可感、可信、可持续的体验，这才是埃安年轻化的分水岭。（雷峰网）
title_norm: 1288万起华为电驱l4同源智驾ray7能成为埃安年轻化的答卷吗
title_en: GAC Aion Ray7 Presale Starts at 128,800 Yuan with Huawei Drive and L4-Derived ADAS

summary_en: GAC Aion opened presales for the Ray7 coupe on Oct 17, starting at 128,800 yuan. It features Huawei DriveONE motors, CATL batteries, 702 km range, and an L4 Robotaxi-derived ADAS model, targeting young buyers and the 200,000-yuan segment.
summary_zh: 10月17日，埃安轿跑Ray7开启预售，12.88万元起，搭载华为DriveONE电驱、宁德时代电池，续航702公里，并采用文远知行L4 Robotaxi同源智驾大模型，瞄准年轻化与20万级市场。

title: Inside the long, bitter fight over one man’s quest to build the biggest AI datacenter in California
summary: A modern-day prospector promised rural Imperial thousands of jobs and millions in tax revenue – but his plan has set off a firestorm of resistance Sebastian Rucci zoomed in on a map in late 2024, looking closely at a large block of brown earth. The barren plot sandwiched between sprawling alfalfa fields and sleepy desert suburbs was exactly what he’d been searching for – the perfect place to realize his dream of building the largest artificial intelligence datacenter in California. The dusty expanse wasn’t an obvious location. It was in the Sonoran desert, just north of the Mexican border, where temperatures regularly rose past 100F (37.8C). Water was scarce in the once-booming agricultural area, which gets its supply from the beleaguered Colorado River. And then, there was the city of Imperial – population 22,000 – to win over. As controversial datacenter projects have sprung up across the US, residents were naturally skeptical of a new, energy-guzzling neighbor. Continue reading...
